llms.body:
# Cisco Networking Academy (NetAcad)

> Cisco Networking Academy (NetAcad) provides free, self-paced and
> instructor-led courses in networking, cybersecurity, programming, AI and
> data science, and professional skills, plus a course catalog,
> partner/academy locator, and career-readiness resources.

Course and curriculum content changes frequently; prefer the catalog and
course pages linked below over cached copies for anything learner- or
enrollment-facing. Pages under `/articles/` support a `?courseLang=` query
parameter for localized variants (default `en-US`).

## Catalog

- [Course catalog](https://www.netacad.com/catalogs/learn): Full searchable catalog of courses, modules, and learning collections.
- [Cybersecurity](https://www.netacad.com/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity courses and certification paths.
  - [Ethical Hacker](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ethical-hacker?courseLang=en-US): Learn the art of offensive security to uncover cyber threats and vulnerabilities before the cybercriminals do.
  - [Cybersecurity Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/cybersecurity-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Cyber attacks increase with every digital connection made around the world. Learn how to protect and defend an organization and gain employable skills to start your cyber career.
  - [CyberOps Associate](https://www.netacad.com/courses/cyberops-associate?courseLang=en-US): Learn how to monitor, detect and respond to cyber threats and prepare for the Cisco Certified Cybersecurity Associate Certification
  - [Endpoint Security](https://www.netacad.com/courses/endpoint-security?courseLang=en-US): Learn to secure your network all the way to the edge.
  - [Introduction to Cybersecurity](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-to-cybersecurity?courseLang=en-US): Explore the exciting field of cybersecurity and why cybersecurity is a future-proof career.
  - [Cyber Threat Management](https://www.netacad.com/courses/cyber-threat-management?courseLang=en-US): Learn about cybersecurity governance and build your skills to manage threats.
  - [Industrial Cybersecurity Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/industrial-cybersecurity?courseLang=en-US): Learn essential cybersecurity concepts for Industrial Systems and practice skills safely with Cisco Packet Tracer and Kali Linux Virtual Machines.
  - [Network Defense](https://www.netacad.com/courses/network-defense?courseLang=en-US): Learn how to monitor and protect your network and evaluate security alerts.
  - [Network Security](https://www.netacad.com/courses/network-security?courseLang=en-US): Learn to protect networks, ensure their integrity, prevent intrusions, and safeguard data from potential threats.
  - [Data and Tools for Defense Analysts](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-data-and-tools-for-defense-analysts?courseLang=en-US): Learn the tools and data sources SOC analysts use to detect and respond to cybersecurity threats effectively.
  - [Introduction to Splunk](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-introduction-to-splunk?courseLang=en-US): Learn to search, analyze, and visualize data with Splunk. No experience needed. Build skills employers want.
  - [Security Operations and the Defense Analyst](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-security-operations-and-the-defense-analyst?courseLang=en-US): Step into the SOC and learn what it takes to become a cybersecurity defense analyst. Real insights from security professionals.
  - [SOC Essentials: Introduction to Threat Hunting](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-soc-essentials-introduction-to-threat-hunting?courseLang=en-US): Learn to proactively hunt for hidden cyber threats before they strike. Master the PEAK Framework with hands-on Splunk exercises.
  - [SOC Essentials: Investigating with Splunk](https://www.netacad.com/courses/soc-essentials-investigating-with-splunk?courseLang=en-US): Master threat investigation with Splunk Enterprise Security. Learn to detect, analyze, and respond to cybersecurity threats.
  - [The Art of Investigation](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-the-art-of-investigation?courseLang=en-US): Step into the SOC and master real-world security investigations through ride-alongs with expert analysts using Splunk.
  - [The Cybersecurity Landscape](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-the-cybersecurity-landscape?courseLang=en-US): Start your journey to becoming a SOC Analyst. Learn core cybersecurity concepts that defend organizations against modern threats.
  - [Understanding Threats and Attacks](https://www.netacad.com/courses/splunk-understanding-threats-and-attacks?courseLang=en-US): Learn to think like an attacker and defend like a pro. Master cyber threats, tactics, and industry-standard security frameworks.
- [Networking](https://www.netacad.com/networking): Networking fundamentals through advanced routing and switching courses.
  - [Networking Basics](https://www.netacad.com/courses/networking-basics?courseLang=en-US): Start learning the basics of computer networking and discover how networks operate.
  - [CCNA: Introduction to Networks](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccna-introduction-networks?courseLang=en-US): The first in a three-course series to build your networking skills and get ready for CCNA certification and associate-level jobs.
  - [CCNP Enterprise: Core Networking (v9)](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccnp-enterprise-core-networking-cu-v26h1?courseLang=en-US): Computer networking is the backbone of all digital communication. Learn how to design intricate network systems and take on challenging network solutions.
  - [CCNP Enterprise: Advanced Routing (v9)](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccnp-enterprise-advanced-routing-cu-v26h1?courseLang=en-US): The Implementing Cisco Enterprise Advanced Routing and Services learning path gives you the knowledge you need to install, operate, manage, and troubleshoot an enterprise network.
  - [DevNet Associate](https://www.netacad.com/courses/devnet-associate?courseLang=en-US): Get ready for DevNet Associate certification and learn software skills, DevOps, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).
  - [CCNP Enterprise: Advanced Routing (v8)](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccnp-enterprise-advanced-routing?courseLang=en-US): The second in a two-course series that prepares you for CCNP certification and professional-level networking jobs.
  - [CCNP Enterprise: Core Networking (v8)](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccnp-enterprise-core-networking?courseLang=en-US): The first in a two-course series to build expertise in networking and prepare for CCNP certification and professional-level jobs.
  - [[BETA] College Board AP Career Kickstart Networking](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ap-ck-networking?courseLang=en-US): A NetAcad learning experience to prepare students for the new AP Networking exam.
  - [[BETA] Data Center Foundations](https://www.netacad.com/courses/data-center-foundations?courseLang=en-US): Prepare for data center roles by learning networking, storage, virtualization, automation, and NX-OS used in modern data centers.
  - [[BETA] Subnetting Mastery](https://www.netacad.com/courses/subnetting-mastery?courseLang=en-US): Learn subnetting through fun games and projects. Start with the basics and work your way up to an expert level.
  - [CCNA: Enterprise Networking, Security, and Automation](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccna-enterprise-networking-security-automation?courseLang=en-US): The third in a three-course series to build your networking skills and get ready for CCNA certification and associate-level jobs.
  - [CCNA: Switching, Routing, and Wireless Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ccna-switching-routing-wireless-essentials?courseLang=en-US): The second in a three-course series to build your networking skills and get ready for CCNA certification and associate-level jobs.
  - [Industrial IoT and Control Systems in Energy](https://www.netacad.com/courses/industrial-iot-and-control-systems-in-energy?courseLang=en-US): Gain skills in Industrial Control systems (ICS) and modern energy systems, and practice with industrial devices using Cisco Packet Tracer.
  - [Industrial IoT and Control Systems in Manufacturing](https://www.netacad.com/courses/industrial-iot-and-control-systems-in-manufacturing?courseLang=en-US): Gain skills in Industrial IoT networking and manufacturing-specific Industrial Automation and Control Systems (IACS) and practice using Cisco Packet Tracer.
  - [Industrial Networking Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/industrial-networking-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Learn fundamental networking concepts for modern industrial architectures and practice with industrial devices in Cisco Packet Tracer.
  - [Introduction to IoT and Digital Transformation](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-iot?courseLang=en-US): Billions of devices connect to the network every day. Learn how IoT is digitally transforming the world and opening up exciting new jobs.
  - [Network Addressing and Basic Troubleshooting](https://www.netacad.com/courses/network-addressing-and-basic-troubleshooting?courseLang=en-US): Take your networking foundation deeper and explore the next steps towards a career in tech.
  - [Network Support and Security](https://www.netacad.com/courses/network-support-security?courseLang=en-US): Develop your network troubleshooting and user access control skills to begin your career in technology.
  - [Networking Devices and Initial Configuration](https://www.netacad.com/courses/networking-devices-and-initial-configuration?courseLang=en-US): Continue learning networking essentials and build your foundational skills.
  - [Networking Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/networking-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Networks keep the digital world connected. Learn how networks work and gain employable skills to start your tech career.
- [AI and Data Science](https://www.netacad.com/ai-data-science): AI and data science courses.
  - [Introduction to Modern AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-to-modern-ai?courseLang=en-US): Learn to use AI in your daily life, craft effective chatbot prompts, and use computer vision and machine translation.
  - [Data Science Essentials with Python](https://www.netacad.com/courses/data-science-essentials-with-python?courseLang=en-US): Learn Python for data analysis with Pandas and Matplotlib, and apply your skills through hands-on, project-based learning.
  - [Data Analytics Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/data-analytics-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Organizations all over the world recognize the value of analytics. Learn the essential tools of the trade.
  - [Introduction to Data Science](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-data-science?courseLang=en-US): Quintillion bytes of data are created EVERY day! Explore how data is transforming the world and opening up exciting new jobs.
  - [Find Insights with AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/apply-ai-find-insights-ai?courseLang=en-US): Learn to transform raw customer feedback into actionable insights through AI-powered thematic analysis. You'll also learn to strategically select AI tools, ensure output reliability, and integrate human oversight for confident decision-making.
  - [Advanced Generative AI Skills](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aitech-advanced-generative-ai-skills?courseLang=en-US): The third and final course in the Cisco AI Technical Practitioner (AITECH) series. Explore AI-driven software engineering, data exploration, AI model customization, workflows, and agentic AI.
  - [AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ibm-foundations-understanding-ai?courseLang=en-US): Part one in a two-course series from IBM SkillsBuild. Learn the core concepts behind AI, including machine learning, neural networks, deep learning, and generative AI.
  - [AI Fundamentals: Language and Vision in AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/ibm-language-vision-ai?courseLang=en-US): Part two in a two-course series from IBM SkillsBuild. Learn how AI processes language, interprets images, powers intelligent agents, and supports real-world applications through technologies like natural language processing, computer vision, generative AI, and AI agents.
  - [AI Power User Launchpad](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aibiz-ai-power-user-launchpad?courseLang=en-US): The third and final course in the Cisco AI Business Practitioner (AIBIZ) learning collection. Build your AI action plan and learn how to bring AI into projects and teams through pilot planning, change management, governance, and responsible use.
  - [AI Technical Practitioner Foundations](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aitech-ai-technical-practitioner-foundations?courseLang=en-US): The first course in the Cisco AI Technical Practitioner (AITECH) series. Explore the generative AI ecosystem, prompt engineering, security, and privacy fundamentals.
  - [Build your Resume with AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/apply-ai-build-your-resume-ai?courseLang=en-US): Use AI to enhance your resume, customize it for jobs, and protect your privacy while staying true to your real experiences.
  - [Core Generative AI Skills](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aibiz-core-generative-ai-skills?courseLang=en-US): The first course in the Cisco AI Business Practitioner (AIBIZ) learning collection. Explore common AI tools, practice prompting, create AI-assisted content, and build responsible AI skills for professional work.
  - [Optimizing Generative AI](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aibiz-optimizing-generative-ai?courseLang=en-US): The second course in the Cisco AI Business Practitioner (AIBIZ) learning collection. Improve the quality and reliability of AI results. Build skills in AI output evaluation, advanced prompting, data analysis, research, brainstorming, and API awareness.
  - [Optimizing Generative AI for Technical Work](https://www.netacad.com/courses/aitech-optimizing-generative-ai-technical-work?courseLang=en-US): The second course in the Cisco AI Technical Practitioner (AITECH) series. Build skills in AI output evaluation, debugging, advanced prompting, and AI-powered discovery.
  - [Prompt Like an Engineer](https://www.netacad.com/courses/apply-ai-prompt-like-engineer?courseLang=en-US): Apply an engineering mindset to AI. Design, iterate & verify prompts, work with local & cloud LLMs, and evaluate outputs.
- [Programming](https://www.netacad.com/programming): Programming and software development courses.
  - [Python Essentials 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/python-essentials-1?courseLang=en-US): Learn fundamental concepts of computer programming and start building coding skills with the Python programming language.
  - [Python Essentials 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/python-essentials-2?courseLang=en-US): Expand your computer programming skills and get ready to earn a certification.
  - [JavaScript Essentials 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/javascript-essentials-1?courseLang=en-US): Design, develop, and improve JavaScript programs. Boost your programming skills to start your career in technology.
  - [JavaScript Essentials 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/javascript-essentials-2?courseLang=en-US): The second in a 2-course series. Gain a strong JavaScript foundation and prepare for JSA – Certified Associate JavaScript Programmer Certification
  - [C++ Essentials 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-plus-plus-essentials-1?courseLang=en-US): Build your C++ programming skills and prepare for CPE – C++ Certified Entry-Level Programmer certification.
  - [HTML Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/html-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Learn the fundamentals of HTML to create structured and interactive web pages from scratch. Perfect for beginners!
  - [C Essentials 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-essentials-1?courseLang=en-US): Build up your C programming skills and prepare for CLE – C Certified Entry-Level Programmer certification.
  - [C Essentials 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-essentials-2?courseLang=en-US): Dive into next-level C programming and prepare for CLA – C Programming Language Certified Associate certification.
  - [C Advanced](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-advanced?courseLang=en-US): Develop advanced C programming skills and prepare for the CLP – C Certified Professional Programmer certification.
  - [C++ Advanced](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-plus-plus-advanced?courseLang=en-US): Advance your C++ skills and prepare for CPP – C++ Certified Professional Programmer certification.
  - [C++ Essentials 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/c-plus-plus-essentials-2?courseLang=en-US): Take your C++ skills to the next level and prepare for CPA – C++ Certified Associate Programmer certification.
  - [CSS Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/css-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Master CSS to style and design beautiful, responsive websites with layouts, animations, and modern design techniques.
- [Information Technology](https://www.netacad.com/information-technology): IT support and systems courses.
  - [IT Support Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/it-support-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Build job-ready skills in hardware, software, and customer service. Your path to CCST IT Support certification.
  - [Operating Systems Basics](https://www.netacad.com/courses/operating-systems-basics?courseLang=en-US): Start learning the basics of computer and mobile devices operating systems.
  - [Linux Essentials](https://www.netacad.com/courses/linux-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Build foundational Linux skills and prepare for the Linux Essentials certificate exam from Linux Professional Institute.
  - [IT Customer Support Basics](https://www.netacad.com/courses/it-customer-support-basics?courseLang=en-US): Develop help desk and customer support skills to succeed in entry-level positions. Learn to manage and troubleshoot IT environments.
  - [Computer Hardware Basics](https://www.netacad.com/courses/computer-hardware-basics?courseLang=en-US): Start learning the basics of computer hardware and discover the components of PCs, laptops and mobile devices.
  - [Linux Unhatched](https://www.netacad.com/courses/linux-unhatched?courseLang=en-US): A quick introduction to the popular operating system, Linux.
  - [Fundamentos de Linux](https://www.netacad.com/courses/fundamentos-de-linux?courseLang=es-XL): Desarrolla habilidades fundamentales en Linux y prepárate para el examen de certificación Linux Essentials del Linux Professional Institute.
  - [Linux 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/linux-1?courseLang=en-US): The first in a 2-course series. Gain a solid Linux foundation and prepare for Linux Professional Institute LPIC-1 certification.
  - [Linux 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/linux-2?courseLang=en-US): The second in a 2-course series preparing you for the Linux Professional Institute LPIC-1 certification. Elevate your Linux skills.
  - [Hardware and Upgrade Support](https://www.netacad.com/courses/hardware-upgrade-support?courseLang=en-US): Your hands-on guide to PC hardware. Learn to diagnose, repair, and upgrade components to launch your IT career.
  - [IT Essentials 8](https://www.netacad.com/courses/it-essentials?courseLang=en-US): Build your IT foundation and gain practical skills in hardware, software, networking, and security.
  - [Operating Systems Support](https://www.netacad.com/courses/operating-systems-support?courseLang=en-US): Continue your learning journey by troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and mobile systems. Improve your customer service skills and prepare for entry-level IT support roles.
  - [Security and Connectivity Support](https://www.netacad.com/courses/security-connectivity-support?courseLang=en-US): Develop foundational IT support skills. Learn to troubleshoot connectivity and defend systems against modern cybersecurity threats.
- [Digital Literacy](https://www.netacad.com/digital-literacy): Introductory digital-skills courses.
  - [Create Digital Content, Communicate and Collaborate Online](https://www.netacad.com/courses/create-communicate-collaborate?courseLang=en-US): Learn to create digital documents and practice using collaborative tools to work effectively in hybrid and remote settings.
  - [Digital Awareness](https://www.netacad.com/courses/digital-awareness?courseLang=en-US): Learn practical digital skills you can apply at home, school, or work, and how to stay safe online.
  - [Digital Safety and Security Awareness](https://www.netacad.com/courses/digital-safety-security?courseLang=en-US): Gain essential skills to protect your personal data, navigate online threats, and ensure your digital well-being with confidence.
  - [Introduction to IoT and Digital Transformation](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-iot?courseLang=en-US): Billions of devices connect to the network every day. Learn how IoT is digitally transforming the world and opening up exciting new jobs.
  - [Using Computer and Mobile Devices](https://www.netacad.com/courses/computer-mobile-devices?courseLang=en-US): Learn basic skills on how to use computer and mobile devices effectively to access online services.
- [Professional Skills](https://www.netacad.com/professional-skills): Career-readiness and soft-skills courses.
  - [Managing a Business Venture](https://www.netacad.com/courses/managing-business-venture?courseLang=en-US): The third in a 3-part entrepreneurship series designed to help you learn business strategy, operations, networking and risk management.
  - [Creating Compelling Reports](https://www.netacad.com/courses/compelling-reports?courseLang=en-US): Learn how to tell a great story and communicate important information to flourish in your professional career.
  - [Discovering Entrepreneurship](https://www.netacad.com/courses/discovering-entrepreneurship?courseLang=en-US): Build entrepreneurial skills and develop a solution-oriented approach to problem solving through real-world examples and interactive branching activities.
  - [Engaging Stakeholders for Success](https://www.netacad.com/courses/engaging-stakeholders?courseLang=en-US): In this course, learners gain the insights and tools to identify, prioritize, and engage with stakeholders for success.
  - [English for IT 1](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-for-it1?courseLang=en-US): A course that teaches the English language in a specific IT context at the “B2” proficiency level which is a basic requirement for employment use.
  - [English for IT 2](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-for-it2?courseLang=en-US): A course that teaches the English language in a specific IT context at the “B2” proficiency level which is a basic requirement for employment use.
  - [English for IT: Advice and Time](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-advice-and-time?courseLang=en-US): Improve your English for IT—learn to give advice, talk about solutions, and share updates in real-world IT scenarios.
  - [English for IT: Describing and Comparing](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-for-it-describing-and-comparing?courseLang=en-US): Learn English for IT to describe, compare, and discuss digital tools and teamwork. Practice making comparisons and explaining processes in real-world IT contexts.
  - [English for IT: Needs and Responsibilities](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-for-it-needs-and-responsibilites?courseLang=en-US): Grow your English for IT to explain roles, plans, responsibilities, and teamwork. Build practical skills for sharing tasks and collaborating confidently in IT settings.
  - [English for IT: People and Quantities](https://www.netacad.com/courses/english-people-and-quantities?courseLang=en-US): Build your English skills for teamwork, resource management, and job roles. Communicate confidently in support, project teams, and online tech communities.
  - [Launching a Business Venture](https://www.netacad.com/courses/business-venture?courseLang=en-US): The second in a 3-course series on entrepreneurship designed to help you advance a business idea from planning to launch.
- [Sustainability](https://www.netacad.com/sustainability): Sustainability-focused courses.
  - [Introduction to Greenhouse Gas Accounting for IT](https://www.netacad.com/courses/introduction-to-greenhouse-gas-accounting-for-it?courseLang=en-US): Expand your IT sustainability skills and dig into the environmental impacts of technology.
- [Badges and Certifications](https://www.netacad.com/badges-certifications): Credentials and certification exams earned through NetAcad courses.

## Programs and community

- [Careers](https://www.netacad.com/careers): Career paths and job-readiness resources for learners.
- [Educators](https://www.netacad.com/educators): Resources for instructors teaching NetAcad courses.
- [Partners](https://www.netacad.com/partners): Information for academy and industry partners.
- [Partner/Academy locator](https://www.netacad.com/partner-locator): Find a local Networking Academy.
- [Become an Academy](https://www.netacad.com/about-skillsforall): Overview of Skills For All and how institutions join.
- [Success stories](https://www.netacad.com/success-stories): Learner and academy outcomes.
- [Community](https://www.netacad.com/community): Community programs and events.
- [Learnathons](https://www.netacad.com/learnathons): Learnathon events.
- [News](https://www.netacad.com/news): Program news and announcements.

## Tools

- [Cisco Packet Tracer](https://www.netacad.com/cisco-packet-tracer): Network simulation tool used across NetAcad courses.
- [Packet Tracer download](https://www.netacad.com/packet-tracer-download): Download Packet Tracer.

## Optional

- [About](https://www.netacad.com/about): Program history and mission.
- [AP / College Board](https://www.netacad.com/ap-college-board): AP and college-credit pathway information.
- [Accessibility](https://www.netacad.com/accessibility): Accessibility statement.
- [Data protection](https://www.netacad.com/data-protection): Privacy and data-handling policy.
- [Terms and policies](https://www.netacad.com/terms-and-policies): Site terms of use.
